name: @wwf971/react-doc-package-cv
description: A react-doc package (doc-package.yaml is its config). Not an npm package; this file marks the folder's .js modules as ES modules for node (tests) and names what its portals are drawn with (doc/cv-portal.md): Material UI for the desk, three.js for the archive room. react and react-dom are the page's own (.npmrc: no copy of them is installed here).
